title: Check Port Listening
description: Check whether a TCP port is listening on the server.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

PORT="${1:-8080}"

if ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -Eq ":${PORT}$|:${PORT}[[:space:]]"; then
    echo "OK: TCP port $PORT is listening."
else
    echo "WARNING: TCP port $PORT is not listening."
    exit 1
fi
